Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The Indian players stride out to the middle. Followed by Brandon King and Kyle Mayers who walk out to open for West Indies. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to start with the new ball. Here we go...
... The Run Chase ...

Obed McCoy is in for a quick chat. He says that it is a great feeling and he is working hard and to perform against a top-side like India is very special. Tells that he has plans and he tries to bowl according to the situation of the game and tells that short boundaries can be intimidating but he just tries to stick to the execution in the middle. Talks about his last wicket and says that he did not hear anything but when other players went up he thought that it is out. Says that it is a special felling to take six wickets.

This was a much better and a collective performance from West Indies. Their bowlers stuck to the plan of using the surface well with the new ball and got off to a solid start with Obed sending back the Indian skipper on the very first delivery. They did manage to capitalize on their dream start and bagged 4 wickets in 7 overs. Later, they managed to keep the run flow in check and did not allow the Indian batters to take the game away from them. Obed McCoy stood out with the ball with his six-wicket haul. Except Odean Smith, everyone was able to get on the wicket's column. Right then, the onus now is on the West Indian batters to chase down this par target and level the series. Will they be able to do that? Stick around to find out how things pan out.

No matter what the combination India goes with, their approach is going to be lethal. India stuck to their plan but their openers could not lay down a solid foundation up top. This did have an effect on their game plan. Only Hardik Pandya was able to get into his 30s and India would be very disappointed with their effort with the blade. The surface has a lot in it for the pacers and India would be hoping to make the most of the conditions as they have added an extra pacer in their squad compared to the first match.

A top-class performance by West Indies. Indian batters were never allowed to settle at the crease and haven't been able to put up a competitive total on the board. This is the lowest ever total by India in the first innings of a T20I game in West Indies.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! India are all-out for 138! Holder nails a perfect yorker, it is on middle and Khan looks to dig it out as he makes a bit of room. However, it is too good for him and the ball goes onto shatter the stumps. Holder gets his second wicket and it has been a brilliant effort from the Windies right from ball one.
In the air but safe. This is a bit full and on off, Arshdeep Singh goes for the big shot but only manages to hit it in the air towards the vacant mid off area. They cross.
WIDE! Holder tries to bowl full and outside off, but it is way outside off. Wided.
Short and on middle and leg, Avesh Khan gets on top of it and pulls it hard towards deep square leg for one.

SIX! Much needed for India. Holder bowls the slower one, on a length and on off, Avesh Khan clears his front leg and heaves it over mid off. It has enough power to take the ball over the fence for a biggie.
Arshdeep Singh is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Obed McCoy gets another one and ends with six wickets. The best figure by a West Indian in a T20I. This is on a good length and around off. Kumar looks to defend it but seems to have missed it. However, the Windies players appeal for a caught behind but the umpire is not interested. Pooran takes the DRS. The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows that there is a nick and Bhuvneshwar Kumar has to walk back. Brilliant from Obed McCoy!
Commentary.Howout: c Devon Thomas b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, on the pads. Khan clips it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Avesh Khan is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A five-wicket haul for Obed McCoy! He has been quite brilliant in this game and gets rewarded with his first fifer in T20Is. This is full and outside off. Ashwin slashes it and slashes it straight to Odean Smith at deep point. He takes a fine catch and India are losing their way now.
Commentary.Howout: c Odean Smith b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: A slower low full toss on middle. Kumar pushes it to long on for a single.
Goes fuller and outside off. Kumar goes chasing for it but misses.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar comes in at number 9.

OUT! CAUGHT! McCoy is on fire as he gets his fourth wicket. This time he gets the danger man Dinesh Karthik. He bowls this a bit short and on middle and leg, Dinesh Karthik tries to paddle it over the short fine leg fielder but mistimes it in the air. The fielder, Alzarri Joseph runs to his left and takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Alzarri Joseph b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! A lucky boundary for Ashwin and India! This is a fullish delivery on middle. Ashwin makes room and looks to heave it towards the leg side. The ball catches the inside edge and goes past stumps towards the fine leg fence.
Goes fuller on middle. Dinesh Karthik flicks it to fine leg for a single.

Smith bowls a length delivery that drifts down the leg side. Karthik looks to clip it but misses. The umpire though does not call it a wide, maybe he thinks that it brushed the pads on the way. Dinesh Karthik is not happy with that call.
On a length, angling into middle. Ashwin pushes it to long on for a single.
FOUR! This time he connects and finds the gap! Shortish length and around off. Ashwin makes room again and cuts it hard over backward point for a boundary.
Short and wide outside off. Ashwin makes a bit of room and slashes hard but misses.
Change. Odean Smith is back into the attack for his final over,
Obed McCoy goes full and it is around off. Dinesh Karthik looks to slog-sweep it but gets the inside edge onto his pads. Brilliant over, just 5 from it and a important wicket.
On a length, on middle. Ashwin works it to mid-wicket for a single. He is off the mark!
Full and on the stumps, Dinesh Karthik drills it down the ground but the long off is pretty straight to cut it out. They only get a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another wicket for Obed McCoy and this time he gets rid of Jadeja. This is full and on off, takes the pace off it. Ravindra Jadeja hops down the track and lofts it high towards the long on fence. It sounded pretty good of the bat but the timing is not there. The ball goes high in the air, Rovman Powell at long on settles under it and makes no mistake. McCoy gets his third and India are six down now. Ravichandran Ashwin is the new batter for India.
Commentary.Howout: c Rovman Powell b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: A low full toss on the stumps, Dinesh Karthik goes down and manages to dig it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Fullish one but way down the leg side. Wided.
Bowls this full and on middle, Ravindra Jadeja mistimes his lofted drive towards long on. They cross.
Back of a length, around off. Jadeja gets across and pulls it to long on for a single.
Angling away from the batter again, it is on a length and outside off. Jadeja looks to cut it but misses.
Serves a length delivery, it is outside off and Jadeja initially looks to scoop it and then tries to adjust his shot. However, he misses the ball completely in the process.

Ohh..just short of Joseph! It is on a length, on off. Jadeja gets low and looks to sweep it away. However, the ball hurries him and he gets a bit of top edge that falls short of Joseph who comes running forward to catch it.
Joseph bangs it short on middle. Dinesh Karthik pulls it firmly to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Jadeja steers it towards third man for a single.
Floated and on leg, Ravindra Jadeja clips it off his pads to deep square leg for one. Akeal Hosein ends his spell with 1-22.
Short and outside off, Dinesh Karthik stays back and cuts it to deep point for a run.
Tossed up on middle and off, Dinesh Karthik keeps it out.

A loud appeal for LBW but turned down. This is floated on middle, angling in, Dinesh Karthik goes for the block but gets hit on his pads. There is an appeal for LBW but the finger stays down. Nicholas Pooran decides against the review.
Darts this one and on the leg stump, Ravindra Jadeja tucks it through mid-wicket for another single.
A bit short and on off, Dinesh Karthik makes room and punches it through covers for one.
Change. Akeal Hosein is back into the attack for his final over.
Keeps it full and angles into the pads again. Dinesh Karthik flicks it to fine leg for a single.
This is full and on the pads. Karthik looks to clip it away but misses. The ball brushes his pads and goes off the bounce to the keeper.
Dinesh Karthik comes in at number 7.

OUT! CAUGHT! Holder follows a yorker with a good short delivery and gets rid of Hardik Pandya! Pandya though will be disappointed with the result of his shot, he timed it pretty well. It is a short delivery angling into middle. Pandya pulls it, he times it nicely but hits it straight down the throat of Odean Smith at deep mid-wicket. It is hit pretty hard and Odean Smith fumbles but manages to grab it eventually. Holder breaks a good 43-run stand between Jadeja and Pandya.
Commentary.Howout: c Odean Smith b Jason Holder

Commentary.Commentary: Nails the yorker! Pandya makes room and Holder follows him and bowls a perfect yorker that hits Pandya on the boot. He seems to be in some pain but nothing serious.
Goes fuller on middle. Jadeja knocks it down to long on for just a single this time.
Holder bowls it very full, outside off. Jadeja squeezes it to right of the sweeper cover for a couple.
Change. Jason Holder (2-0-10-0) is back into the attack now.
A slower one, short and on leg, Ravindra Jadeja pulls it down towards fine leg for a single.
Fullish one and on off, Hardik Pandya forces it towards long off for one. With that, the 100 comes up for India.
On a length and outside off, Hardik Pandya tries to hit it too hard but only manages to inside edge it towards the keeper.
Bangs this short and outside off, Hardik Pandya shuffles across and pulls it hard in front of square on the leg side for a brace.
Good length and on middle and leg, Ravindra Jadeja moves to the leg side and guides it to third man for a single.
Bowls it full and on leg from 'round the wicket, Ravindra Jadeja flicks it staright to short mid-wicket.
A length delivery angling into middle from 'round the wicket at 136 clicks. Jadeja uses his wrists and hits it to long on for another single. Smith continues to be expensive, 12 from this over!
On a length, on middle. Pandya knocks it down to long on for a single.
Short and wide again, Bit pacy this time and Pandya slashes at it. However, he misses this time.

SIX! Wow! What a shot! This is short and outside off. Pandya stays still and slams it over deep extra-cover for a biggie. Pandya is in the form of his life at the moment and India need him to bat till the end here.
Back of a length, around off. Jadeja guides it to third man for a single.

TWO WIDES! Wayward stuff from Smith! He bowls it short and way down the leg side. Devon Thomas behind the stumps dives to his left and gets a hand to it. He slows the pace of the ball as the ball deflects towards fine leg. A bye taken.
Short and wide outside off. Jadeja cuts it to point. The fielder there dives and stops it. Just a single taken.
Odean Smith is back on. Two overs for 21 runs so far.

TURN AND BOUNCE! This is nicely tossed up on middle, inviting the drive from the batter. Pandya obliges and goes for the drive but gets beaten on his outside edge by the sharp turn. The keeper cannot collect it properly as he gets hit on his chest. If he had collected it properly it would have been interesting as Pandya's back leg was in the air for a bit.
Floated on off, Hardik Pandya guides it to point.
Slightly shorter and on off, Hardik Pandya stays back and slaps it towards deep mid-wicket. A fumble there by Powell and the batter comes back for the second.
Flighted delivery around off, Hardik Pandya defends it of his outer part to the off side.
Pulls his length back a bit, Jadeja tries to sweep it to the leg side but gets a top edge over the keeper. They cross.
SIX! Wonderful use of the feet by Jadeja. This is tossed up on off, Ravindra Jadeja dances down the track and smokes it over the bowler's head for a biggie.

Just a single to the end the over, six singles from this over! A full slower delivery on middle. Jadeja works it right of deep mid-wicket for a single. He initially looks for the second run but decides against it in the end.
Drifts on the pads again. This is fuller in length and Pandya flicks it to fine leg for a single.
A slower yorker, outside off. Jadeja flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Bit of hesitation but an easy single in the end. On a length, on leg. Pandya clips it to short fine leg and inititally hesitates to take a single but Jadeja calls him and they complete it easily in the end.
Bowls it short, on off. Jadeja pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for another single.
On a length, on middle. Pandya pushes it to long on for a single.
Another good over by Akeal Hosein. This is pushed through quicker and on off, Ravindra Jadeja makes room and dabs it to point. Only 2 runs from the over.
A bit short and down the leg, Hardik Pandya helps it towards fine leg for another run.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Hardik Pandya nudges it to mid-wicket for one.
Nice delivery. This is slower through the air, holds its line and bounces of the deck, Hardik Pandya blocks it out watchfully.
Flatter and on middle and leg, Ravindra Jadeja stays back and eases it to long on for a single.
Floated on off, turning in a bit, Ravindra Jadeja knocks it to short mid-wicket.
Bangs it short again, around off. Jadeja pulls it firmly to deep mid-wicket for a single. Just 4 from the over, good start from Holder!
On a length, on middle. Pandya works it with the angle towards mid-wicket for a single.
Seems like the Windies bowlers have decided to keep their length on the shorter side. It is a short one angling into middle from 'round the wicket and Jadeja pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Short of good length and around off. Jadeja chops it to the point fielder.
Again the same length, it is angling into the body and Pandya works it wide of mid on for a single.
Holder starts off with the shorter length, it is angling into off. Pandya rides the bounce and defends it towards the leg side.
Tossed up, around off. Pandya works it to mid on for one. A wicket-taking over by Hosein comes to an end.

Half a chance! It is fuller, on off. Jadeja comes down the track and pushes it aerially to the left of the bowler. Hosein moves to that side but does not get near the ball. They take as the ball goes to long on.
Floated and full, outside off. Jadeja blocks it back to the bowler on the front foot.
Ravindra Jadeja is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT!  Hosein gets his man and sends Pant back in the hut. He bowls this a bit fuller and outside off, Rishabh Pant skips down the track and tries to heave it over the deep mid-wicket fence against the wind. However, he cannot use all of his power and ends up mistiming his shot. The ball goes in the air towards deep mid-wicket. Odean Smith sprints to his right in the deep and pouches the ball safely. India loses another.
Commentary.Howout: c Odean Smith b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nice shot! This is a bit short and on middle, Rishabh Pant picks the length early and goes down and hooks it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Starts with a flatter delivery and down the leg, Hardik Pandya tucks it through square leg for one.
Change. Akeal Hosein comes into the attack now.
Smith continues to be tad short and around off. Pandya powers it to sweeper cover for a single.
On the shorter side again, around off. Pandya punches it to covers this time.
Nice carry again! It is short and around off. The ball is just short of good length and bounces sharply to beat the outside edge of Pandya's blade as he looks to push it away.
SIX! What a shot! India continue their aggressive approach! Short and wide outside off. Pandya waits for it and cuts it over the point fence for a maximum. Fantastic shot!
Shorter in length again, it is outside off and Pant cuts it to deep point for a single.
Smith starts his second over with a back-of-a-length delivery, around off. Pant punches it to the cover fielder in the ring.
Length and on off. Pandya stays back and blocks it to covers.
FOUR! This is the first boundary of the innings. We have only seen maximums till now. It is full, outside off. Hardik Pandya strides forward and creams it through mid off for a cracking boundary.
Joseph serves it on a length, on top of off. This one flies off the deck as well. Hardik Pandya stays back and defends it out watchfully.
FOUR LEG BYES! A short ball, angled down leg, Hardik Pandya misses his flick. It goes past the keeper off his thigh pads. It races away to the fine leg fence. The umpire signals leg byes.
Hardik Pandya walks out at number 5!

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! The change of ends has worked for Alzarri Joseph here. He gets his first wicket. Joseph hits the hard length, wide outside off, it shapes in a touch with some extra bounce. Shreyas Iyer tries to slash it away from inside the crease but only gets an outside edge towards the keeper. Devon Thomas gathers it safely with both hands above his head. The surface is doing the trick here for the hosts.
Commentary.Howout: c Devon Thomas b Alzarri Joseph

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, sliding into the pads, Iyer tries to clip it away but misses. He gets rapped on his pads.
Change of ends for Alzarri Joseph. He is back on after an expensive first over which went for 17 runs.
Good length, around off, blocked to backward point.

In the air but safe! Full length, outside off. Rishabh Pant stays back and throws his blade at it. He ends up slicing it towards long off. The fielder from mid off gives it a chase but it lands safely in front of him. They take two.
SIX! Innovative and effective. It is a short ball, on middle and leg. Rishabh Pant shuffles across and smokes it over the fine leg fence.

Great running yet again! It is a length ball, on the pads, Pant flicks it into the gap at mid-wicket. Odean Smith gives it a chase. The call is for two, they push hard for the first one, but denied the second as the fielder reached it. Although he fumbles, which allows them to take another run.
A short ball, on off. Pant pulls it to deep mid-wicket along the ground. The batters push hard and gets back for the second run convincingly.
Back of a length, outside off. Iyer stays back and slaps it to mid off for a quick single.
Odean Smith is into the attack now as he replaces Alzarri Joseph.

Great fielding by the skipper this time. Setting up an example for his side. It is full, outside off. Shreyas Iyer leans in and drives it over covers. Nicholas Pooran gives it chase and keeps it in play with a brilliant dive in the nick of time. The batters take three.
Slightly short, on off. Iyer hops inside the crease and defends it out.
Length ball, on off. Pant pushes it to cover for a single.
SIX! This is huge! A freebie for Pant's standard. It is full, sliding down leg. Pant stays back and flicks it over the square leg fence for a biggie. He is making his intent clear.
Touch fuller, on off. Pant blocks it to cover.
Rishabh Pant walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another man bites the dust for India. Obed McCoy gets his second wicket of the innings. He has sent back both the openers in a jiffy. It is full, outside off, angling across the right-hander. Suryakumar Yadav tries to drive on the up, but only manages to get a thick outside edge. Devon Thomas makes no mistake behind the stick. India in a spot.
Commentary.Howout: c Devon Thomas b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! All the way! Shreyas Iyer now gets into the act. Fuller length, outside off. It is a half-volley. Shreyas Iyer tonks it over the wide long on fence for a maximum.
Into the gap! It is full, on the pads. Suryakumar Yadav stays back and wrists it through mid-wicket. Three runs taken.
Overthrows! Fuller, on off. Yadav pushes it to extra cover. The batters take one. There is an overthrow which allows the batters to sneak another one.

SIX! Suryakumar Yadav gets off the mark with a biggie. It is a length ball, outside off, Suryakumar Yadav expands his arms and lofts it over extra cover. He hits it clean enough to send it into the stands.
Suryakumar Yadav stays back to this good length delivery and dabs it down to short third man.
A length ball, on off. Yadav stays back and defends it out solidly.
Alzarri Joseph will start from the other end.
A wicket-maiden for Obed McCoy. An incredible start for the hosts. It is full, on middle and leg. Shreyas Iyer clips it to mid-wicket.
McCoy dishes it full and on off. Iyer blocks it out watchfully.
Hits it too straight! It is full, on off. Iyer leans forward, drives it down the ground, only to disturb the stumps at the non-striker's end.
Touch short, on middle and leg. Iyer tucks it to square leg.
McCoy fires it full, on off. Shreyas Iyer stays back and blocks it out watchfully.
Shreyas Iyer walks out at number 3!

OUT! CAUGHT! A dream start for West Indies. Rohit Sharma walks back on a golden duck. Obed McCoy starts his spell with a good-length delivery, around off. This one flies off the deck. It get big on Rohit Sharma. He lifts his blade to block it out but gets it to short third man off the thick outside edge. Akeal Hosein leaps and takes a sharp catch over his head. Timed his jump to perfection.
Commentary.Howout: c Akeal Hosein b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: We are all set to begin! The West Indies players are in the huddle. They disperse now to take their respective positions. Rohit Sharma and Suryakumar Yadav are the openers for India. So, India sticking with SKY at the top of the order but he has come out wearing Arshdeep Singh's T-shirt out in the middle. Remember, the reason for the delay? Anyway, the West Indies players now take the knee in support of the Black Lives Matter movement while the Indian players keep their hand on the heart in support of the movement. It will be Obed McCoy to start with the ball. Here we go...

Rohit Sharma, the skipper of India starts by saying that the first game was quite pleasing. It was not the easiest of the pitch but they managed to stuck to their plan. Mentions they want the guys to bat anywhere. T20 cricket is a different form of cricket and aims that the boys are flexible enough but cenrtain players are meant for certain roles and they need to focus on that. Adds, with the wind blowing across heavily they wanted to try an extra pacer. Hence Avesh Khan comes in for Ravi Bishnoi. Ends by saying it is very unfortunate for Bishnoi to miss out.

Nicholas Pooran, the skipper of West Indies, says that they will bowl first. He says that the wicket looks really nice and they will look to chase down the total. He adds that they will look to improve from the last game and execute their plans better in this one. He says that it's a new ground and new conditions and they will look to play according to it. He ends by saying Keemo Paul and Shamarh Brooks are out and Brandon King and Devon Thomas replaces them.

India (Playing XI) - Rohit Sharma (C), Suryakumar Yadav, Shreyas Iyer, Rishabh Pant (WK), Hardik Pandya, Ravindra Jadeja, Dinesh Karthik, Ravichandran Ashwin, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Arshdeep Singh, Avesh Khan (In place of Ravi Bishnoi).

West Indies (Playing XI) - Kyle Mayers, Devon Thomas (WK) (In place of Keemo Paul), Brandon King (In place of Shamarh Brooks), Jason Holder, Nicholas Pooran (C), Rovman Powell, Shimron Hetmyer, Akeal Hosein, Odean Smith, Alzarri Joseph, Obed McCoy.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Nicholas Pooran. West Indies have elected to BOWL first.

As we wait for the action to unfold, let's just try to figure out the team combination India might go with in today’s game. The usual cricketing nous says that after a comfortable win in the first game, India will field an unchanged XI. However, will they open with SKY alongside Rohit Sharma again? Or will they go back to Pant who was opening with Rohit in England? Another option will be to replace Pant with either Ishan Kishan or Sanju Samson. Kishan has done quite well in the opportunities he has got so far while we all know what Sanju Samson can bring to the table. Indian team selection nowadays has become quite fascinating and we should probably stop with the discussion as this discussion can get endless and we are still not into the middle order and bowling department. We shall probably just wait for the toss and figure out what Rohit Sharma and team management decide. Toss is just a few minutes away…
